PRESS RELEASE TEMPLATE
======================

Copy this file and replace every [bracketed] part. Use an author email,
not a personal one. City and state only in the dateline — no home address.

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
---------------------

[Headline — under 12 words]

[Sub-headline — one line, why it matters]

[City], [State] — [Month Day, Year] — [Author name] today announced the
release of [Book title], a [genre/category] book [published by
[publisher or "self-published"]]. [One sentence describing the book and
who it is for.]

[Second sentence: the problem the book solves and why it matters now.]

[Author name] is a [credential/role] based in [state]. [One sentence of
background.]

"I wrote this book because..." — [Author name]

[Book title] is available at [retailers]. [Format and price, optional.]

About [Author name] / Asdale Dynamics, LLC:
[Two or three sentences about who you are and what you publish.]

###

Media contact:
[Author name]
[Author email]
[Website]

WHERE TO SEND IT (FREE)
-----------------------
- Local newspaper (city desk or community editor)
- Local radio stations and community calendars
- Library newsletters and bookstore event coordinators
- Bloggers and newsletter writers in your topic area (find them yourself;
  never buy media lists)
